g.text: C. Ready-prefix early holding (not physical memory release)
Sum of three PREFIX_READY idle intervals, ms; median labels
Changes to launch method and ETA are separate controls. Timing actions are scripted; real tools execute.
Fixed EWMA and 5 ms margin; no evaluation tuning. Both-lower pair counts and negative results are in the report.
